messages:
laura: Heads-up — starting preflight for the private-vpc release transport at 16:00 PT. packing artifacts now, ETA ~15m. please ack if you need a different window :clock4:
nikhil: ack. building sealed image set (multi-arch) and shrinkwrap now. pushing to staging mirror.
emily: noted. will reserve the escort lane and watch for signer delays. if cosign fails we'll abort and hand back to packaging.
deploybot: [info] triggered: private-vpc-packaging/v0.29.3 -> canary group vpc-region-3. artifacts: installer-0.29.3.tgz, imageset-0.29.3-sha256. Starting rollout step 1/4.
sam: quick Q — are we pinning the repo tag or using the epoch hash for this canary?
laura: pin to epoch hash. packaging observed a transient tag rewrite last month; we want immutable references for onprem customers.
nikhil: confirmed. using sealed-epoch: e3a9f2c. will publish a submanifest with cosign sig and md5->sha256 mapping.
olga: security check — cosign signer will be rotated today at 17:00. if the signer key TTL expires during rollout we need fallback signer list. can packaging include alternate cosign certs?
emily: yes, we maintain signer mirror. will add signer B as fallback in the installer manifest. ops will prefer signer A unless verification fails.
boris: oncall: if the canary shows >1.5x latency on install step 2 (image fetch) within the first 10 hosts, we should pause and auto-rollback. what's the rollback trigger here?
laura: rollback trigger = failed integrity verification OR >30% host failures OR sustained image pull latency >1.5x baseline for 10m. manual hold until lead signoff otherwise.
sam: can deploybot be configured to auto-pin older image variant (quantized-x64-0.28.9) as fallback rather than full abort? that would reduce outage for customers.
emily: yes we support auto-fallback routing to compatible variant. adding: deploybot fallback policy = try variant-compat v0.28.9 for 3 attempts, then abort.
deploybot: [plan] applying fallback policy: variant-compat:v0.28.9 set for canary group. will attempt up to 3 auto-switches before abort and notify #eng-releases.
nikhil: FYI, signer latency observed on last run: cosign server responded ~1.2s median but had 5s tail at 99p. I'm adding a short retry loop in packaging to tolerate 6s spikes.
olga: good. also enable offline verification option in installer (skip-network-keys) for airgap installs — that path must use the alternate pre-shared signer bundle.
laura: release notes draft: "Private/VPC 0.29.3 — installer: improved alternate-signer handling, image fallback routing, and tightened rollback criteria. Packaging uses sealed epoch hash for immutable pins." passing to docs for formatting.
boris: will be watching logs. if anything spikes I'll post stack snippets here. please include the deploybot run id in messages: db-6187654321-rc1.
sam: noted. tagging the release in internal changelog and adding eval prompt set for asap.
deploybot: [success] step 1/4 canary applied to 5 hosts (region vpc-region-3). healthchecks OK. proceeding to step 2 in 10m. run_id=db-6187654321-rc1
laura: thanks everyone. next checkpoint at step 2 start (6187654361). if no blockers we aim for full fanout at 18:00 PT. :thumbsup:
